**Best pick for most iPhone 17 owners: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**

It's about as thin as a card, and it charges at 15W, the fastest speed available on a slim bank. It's $54.99 at Anker, with a $5 auto-applied discount at the time of the page snapshot. [Buy it here](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)

- **Size:** 0.34 in thick, 4.3 oz (122 g) ([Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank))
- **Capacity:** 5,000 mAh, which 9to5Mac says is enough for a meaningful top-up but not a full charge ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/))
- **Wireless:** 15W Qi2 on iPhone 12 through 17 ([Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank))
- **Caveat:** Anker's compatibility notes say "iPhone models 12 through 16," but its spec list includes the iPhone 17 series. Check the current listing if this matters to you.

**Other slim options**

| Bank | Capacity | Wireless | Thickness / weight | Price (per source) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Baseus Picogo Air AM71 | 5,000 mAh | 7.5W | 0.27 in / 104 g | $52.99 at Amazon | Thinnest and lightest tested, with NFC battery check ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)) |
| ReelCharge ReelSafe | 5,000 mAh | 15W | 0.35 in / 119 g | $49.99 | Semi-solid-state battery, LED display ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)) |
| INIU SnapGo Air | 10,000 mAh | 25W Qi2.2 | 0.5 in / 195 g | $42.99 at Amazon | Best value for fast charging; includes a 60W braided cable ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)) |

The Baseus AM71 is the slimmest, but its 7.5W wireless speed is slow for topping up an iPhone 17 quickly. The INIU gives you more battery and much faster charging, at about twice the thickness and weight.

**Higher capacity option: Baseus PicoGo AM52**

This is a 10,000 mAh, 25W Qi2.2 bank with 45W USB-C output. It's listed at $59.99, or $53.99 with code AM52 at Baseus's US store, though the store's checkout has the final say ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)). Thickness isn't listed in the sources, so it's likely bulkier than the Anker. Dealectric is an affiliate site, and it earns a commission if you buy through its link.

**Things to know for iPhone 17**

- 25W wireless needs an iPhone 16 or later, but not the 16e. The iPhone Air tops out around 20W even on a 25W charger ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)).
- Metal cards, keys, or thick non-magnetic cases can interfere with magnetic alignment ([Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)).
- Apple's own MagSafe battery is $99 and only supports up to 12W on the iPhone Air, so third-party Qi2 banks are faster ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)).

**Recommendation:** Get the Anker Nano if you want the slimmest bank that still charges at 15W. Get the INIU SnapGo Air if you want more battery and 25W speed and can accept a thicker bank. I didn't find buy links for the INIU or Baseus AM71 in the search results, so search Amazon or the brand site for those.

Sources: [Android Central, Oct 2026](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge), [Macworld, updated Oct 2026](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html), [9to5Mac, June 2026](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/), [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w).
